content.json:
# Arc - SQL Server Monitoring Workbook

This workbook provides comprehensive insights into your Arc-enabled SQL Server estate, including inventory, configuration, security, and compliance status.

---

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.query:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
| distinct resourceGroup
| sort by resourceGroup asc

content.title: SQL Server Instances
content.subtitle: Total Arc-enabled SQL Server instances

content.title: SQL Server Databases
content.subtitle: Total databases across all instances

content.title: Defender Protected
content.subtitle: Instances protected by Azure Defender

content.title: Encrypted Databases
content.subtitle: Databases with encryption enabled

content.query:
// Database details per SQL Server instance
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances/databases"
{ResourceGroup:filters}
| summarize 
    Databases=count(),
    OfflineDBs=sum(toint(iif(tostring(properties["state"]) != "Online", 1, 0))),
    TotalSizeMB=sum(toint(iif(tostring(properties["sizeMB"]) != "", properties["sizeMB"], 0))) 
    by Instance = tostring(split(tostring(id), "/")[8])
| extend TotalSizeGB = round(TotalSizeMB / 1024.0, 2)
| project Instance, Databases, OfflineDBs, TotalSizeGB
| order by TotalSizeGB desc 
| take 20
content.title: Database Details per SQL Server Instance
content.subtitle: Top 20 instances by database size

content.query:
// SQL Server versions distribution
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
{ResourceGroup:filters}
| extend version = tostring(properties['version'])
| summarize Count=count() by version
| order by version asc
content.title: SQL Server Versions
content.subtitle: Distribution of SQL Server versions

content.title: SQL Server Editions
content.subtitle: Distribution by SQL Server edition

content.title: Database Compatibility Levels
content.subtitle: Distribution of database compatibility levels

content.title: Azure Defender for SQL Server
content.subtitle: Protection status distribution

content.title: Database Encryption Status
content.subtitle: Encrypted vs non-encrypted databases

content.query:
// SQL Server edition classification
resources
| where type == 'microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances'
{ResourceGroup:filters}
| extend version = tostring(properties.version)
| extend edition = properties.edition
| extend containerId = tolower(tostring(properties.containerResourceId))
| extend serverClass = iff(edition in ("Enterprise", "Standard"), "Enterprise/Standard", "Express/Developer/Other") 
| summarize count() by serverClass
content.title: SQL Server Edition Classification
content.subtitle: Enterprise/Standard vs other editions

content.query:
// SQL Server instance license summary
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
{ResourceGroup:filters}
| extend d=parse_json(properties) 
| extend Patch=d["patchLevel"]
| extend SQLVersion=d["version"]
| extend Edition=d["edition"]
| extend License=d["licenseType"]
| summarize InstanceCount=count() by License=tostring(License), Edition=tostring(Edition)
| order by InstanceCount desc
content.title: Instance License Summary
content.subtitle: License type and edition distribution

content.title: Extension License Types
content.subtitle: Arc extension license distribution

content.json:
## Tag-based Analysis

*Note: Update the tag names in the queries below to match your organization's tagging strategy.*

content.query:
// SQL Server instances by Application tag
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
{ResourceGroup:filters}
| extend application = tostring(tags.Application)
| where isnotempty(application)
| summarize ServerCount = count() by application
| order by ServerCount desc
content.title: SQL Server Instances by Application
content.subtitle: Distribution by 'Application' tag

content.query:
// SQL Server instances by Location tag
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
{ResourceGroup:filters}
| extend location = tostring(tags.Location)
| where isnotempty(location)
| summarize ServerCount = count() by location
| order by ServerCount desc
content.title: SQL Server Instances by Location
content.subtitle: Distribution by 'Location' tag

content.query:
// SQL Server instances by DataCenter tag
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
{ResourceGroup:filters}
| extend dataCenter = tostring(tags.DataCenter)
| where isnotempty(dataCenter)
| summarize ServerCount = count() by dataCenter
| order by ServerCount desc
content.title: SQL Server Instances by Data Center
content.subtitle: Distribution by 'DataCenter' tag

content.query:
// SQL Server instances by Business Unit tag
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
{ResourceGroup:filters}
| extend businessUnit = tostring(tags.BusinessUnit)
| where isnotempty(businessUnit)
| summarize ServerCount = count() by businessUnit
| order by ServerCount desc
content.title: SQL Server Instances by Business Unit
content.subtitle: Distribution by 'BusinessUnit' tag

content.query:
// Detailed SQL Server instance inventory
resources
| where type == "microsoft.azurearcdata/sqlserverinstances"
{ResourceGroup:filters}
| extend d=parse_json(properties)
| project 
    Name = name,
    ResourceGroup = resourceGroup,
    Location = location,
    Version = tostring(d["version"]),
    Edition = tostring(d["edition"]),
    PatchLevel = tostring(d["patchLevel"]),
    LicenseType = tostring(d["licenseType"]),
    DefenderStatus = tostring(d["azureDefenderStatus"]),
    ContainerResourceId = tostring(d["containerResourceId"])
| order by Name asc
content.title: SQL Server Instance Inventory
content.subtitle: Detailed information for all Arc-enabled SQL Server instances
